text:
**No qualifying deforestation was detected after 2020.** The data show 0.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, but it occurred in patches smaller than the 0.5-hectare minimum event size. The JRC reference also identified no forest on the asset in 2020.

The available annual data extend through 2025. Earlier tree-cover losses, including in 2020, fall outside the post-2020 assessment period.
